brainlife.desc: Directory of per-tract .tck files with a tcks.json index giving each tract's name, colour and file.
brainlife.name: neuro/tcks

original.desc: collection of tck files with json file describing each tck file

file_descs.tcks_json: A json file containing a list of object for each tck files stored inside the tcks directory.

brainlife.readme:
tcks.json sample

```
[
    {
        "name": "forcepsMinor",
        "color": [0.8147236864,0.2550951155,0.004634224134],
        "filename": "forcepsMinor.json"
    },
    {
        "name": "forcepsMajor",
        "color": [0.9057919371,0.5059570517,0.7749104647],
        "filename": "forcepsMajor.json"
    },
]
```

**Sharing:** Tier 2 (pseudonymised participant-level) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.tcks.json

files.desc: Directory with one .tck file per tract.
A json file containing a list of object for each tck files stored inside the tcks directory.

identifying_risks: Individual white matter geometry can support re-linkage as a structural fingerprint
Headers and metadata may carry subject codes or acquisition dates
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 4: participant-level processed neurodata without direct identifiers. Tier 4 conditions apply if used as a connectome fingerprint.
sharing_cautions: Share with coded subject IDs under a data use agreement
Strip free-text tags and dates from metadata before release
tier_conditions: Tier 1 only once aggregated across participants (e.g. a population atlas)
Tier 4 if used to build connectome fingerprints or predictive features
